title: The Doom Slayer's final enemy in DOOM Eternal
subject: doomslayer
description:
Should the Slayer have spared Davoth? 👇

How the Doom Slayer's war in DOOM Eternal ended with an enemy made in his own image. Spoilers for DOOM Eternal and The Ancient Gods Part Two.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by id Software or Bethesda Softworks. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: His final enemy looked almost exactly like the Doom Slayer.
In Doom Eternal, the Slayer drove the Crucible into the Icon of Sin and saved Earth.
The Ancient Gods Part Two brought him to the Dark Lord Davoth, the ruler behind Hell.
Davoth revealed the Slayer had been made in his image, a copy of his own power.
The Slayer didn't argue. He ended the fight, and the Dark Lord with it.
Fans believe killing Davoth also cut off the source of the Slayer's own strength.
In the end, he destroyed the one being who shared his face.
